body.statement: Along the explicit path \(n_\ell=2\ell\) and \(m_\ell=2\lceil\gamma\ell\rceil\), determine \(C_\star\), decide whether recorded IPW-SVD attains it among \(\mathcal O_{n_\ell,m_\ell}\)-measurable estimators, and characterize whether a nonconstant predictable propensity path can be least favorable.
body.justification: Rate matching does not determine the local information geometry.
body.gap: No cited adaptive low-rank result computes this maximum-row minimax constant.
body.consumer: The answer determines whether personalization can be optimized for inferential efficiency.

obligation.what_is_open: Determine the exact local information experiment and its maximum-row minimax constant, then compare its optimal estimator with recorded IPW--SVD.
obligation.obstruction: The rate-normalized lower packing supplies only an unspecified positive constant, while the valid uniform upper bound is at a larger adaptive spectral radius.  The explicit endogenous-factor law also shows that recorded IPW--SVD is not uniformly \(b_{nm}\)-rate attaining on the frozen class.  Neither result identifies the local likelihood geometry needed for \(C_\star\).
obligation.attempted: A row-local constant-propensity Fano packing was completed, and a filtration-preserving adaptive construction was used to test IPW--SVD.  These settle a positive converse and refute uniform sharp attainment but do not yield a least-favorable local asymptotic experiment.
obligation.partial_result: The fixed-propensity Fano construction proves a positive \(b_{n_\ell m_\ell}\)-normalized lower bound when \(\mu>1\).  The valid uniform achievability result from the frozen class is only the explicit spectral loose radius \(a^{\mathrm{loose}}_{n_\ell m_\ell}\), and the adaptive endogenous-factor construction proves that recorded IPW--SVD need not attain the smaller \(b_{n_\ell m_\ell}\) scale.  These facts bound neither the exact likelihood information constant nor the best risk of all observed-data estimators sharply enough to determine \(C_\star\).
